Freeze the exact message bytes, owner recovery and signature normalization, HKDF salt and info labels before obtaining any signature result.

Request actual MetaMask personal_sign on a test-only EOA, then repeat after restart and in Firefox. Keep mnemonic, signature and derived keys out of shared artifacts; record public keys or non-secret digests only.
